title: Map production affine q_u/u response to real SWAP corrector flux and accepted interface ledger
corrector_authority: Real SWAP corrector q_swap is reconstructed from the accepted whole-window bottom outward exchange for a prescribed groundwater head. Accepted ledger exchange is the integrated mass authority after publication.
preregistered_outputs: initial affine q at H_ref and production affine slope dq_u/dH
real area-weighted corrector q_swap(H) at all fixed offsets from H_ref
central finite-difference corrector slopes at 1e-6, 5e-6 and 1e-5 m
ratio of corrector FD slope to production affine slope, when denominator is nonzero
initial affine/corrector intercept mismatch at H_ref
live coupled final head and per-tile corrector fluxes
accepted per-tile ledger exchange and equality to area_fraction*q_tile*duration_s
gates: all fixed-head real SWAP trials are valid, finite and discarded back to the immutable origin
area-weighted corrector flux equals 0.35*q1+0.65*q2 within machine-scale arithmetic
repeated H_ref trial is deterministic within machine-scale arithmetic
all finite-difference slopes are finite; no equality to production u/dt is required
existing F-GC45 live coupled window converges and publishes once
sum of tile ledgers = q_weighted_final*duration_s within 1e-12 m
interpretation_rules: Treat q_u/u as a production response approximation until separately matched to physical mass/storage terms.
Treat corrector q_swap and committed ledger exchange as physical interface-exchange authority for the accepted window.
A numerical match between u and an FD slope does not by itself prove u is physical storage.
A mismatch does not by itself prove the production coupling is wrong; distinguish predictor approximation, reference choice and corrector nonlinearity.
Do not infer a finite-resistance q-link unless two distinct physical interface heads and a physical conductance law are independently present.
forbidden: no retuning of offsets or tolerances after observing results
no claim about heterogeneous upscaling from this identical-physics two-tile fixture
